The following events took place in '''79 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*During a visit to [[Qui-Gon Jinn's homeworld|his homeworld]] at age thirteen, [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] obtains a [[River stone|Force-sensitive stone]] from the [[River of Light]], which he keeps as a memento for over thirty [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="THP">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Hidden Past]]''</ref> {{Circa}}<ref name="Jinn">Based on [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] birth year of [[92 BBY/Legends|92 BBY]] given in [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']], p. xx {{C|Time Line}}, it can be concluded that he was thirteen around 79 BBY.</ref>
